title: The app is good But
body:
It works well with the watch however there are lot of Down points in regards to integration with other apps. In simple words on the iPhone it wouldn’t integrate with any other app such as Strava or MyFitnessPal for example. 
The data it syncs with Apple health is very minimal. 
If those things were available it would easily get 5 stars. 
Other brands like xiaomi or Huawei wearable apps for example it’s made so easy to integrate even they send all the data to Apple health if we choose to such as sleep data etc.
